finding: H1 (regression from the four same-night commits) is ruled out by source diff, not just build reproduction. Every desk-computable representation of this exact build -- the routed-netlist cycle-sim, an independent physical-pip-tree reconstruction against the chipdb hrdata-lane table, and bitgens own cross-net mux-ownership conflict check -- agrees the intended/logical encoding is 0x4147414d, matching the 2026-08-02 L48-qualified value. Also notable: examples/designs/mcu_ahb_constant_slave.v and agamemnon/rtl/mcu_ahb_constant_slave.v have not changed since they were added on 2026-08-02 (commit 1957fd8, the same day as the original qualification); the differing design_source_sha256/endpoint_rtl_sha256 recorded in the two 2026-08-02 trials above versus this trial reflect pre-checkin normalization, not an RTL change. This design also has zero pack_regression.json byte-identity coverage (no routed JSON is retained for it there), so a toolchain-drift change to its routing would not be caught by CI today.
